Graphene segmentation layers

Source: R/graphene.R
ngs_graphene_layer.Rd

Segmentation layers for graphene (CAVE chunkedgraph) sources such as FlyWire. Constructed layers are set up for mainline neuroglancer and Spelunker (type "segmentation" with a "graphene://middleauth+" source). Use ngs_as_flavour() or ngs_for_viewer() to convert them for other neuroglancer flavours.

Usage

ngs_graphene_layer(source, name = "segmentation", ...)

ngs_flywire_layer(name = "flywire_production", ...)

ngs_fanc_layer(name = "fanc", ...)

Arguments

source

A graphene source ("graphene://..."), see layers.

name

The layer name. Names are made unique when the layer is added to a scene.

...

Further fields of the layer state, e.g. segments, visible = FALSE or shader.

Value

A graphene layer, which is also a segmentation layer.

Details

ngs_flywire_layer() and ngs_fanc_layer() are shortcuts for the FlyWire production and FANC segmentations.

Examples

fw <- ngs_graphene_layer(
  "graphene://https://prod.flywire-daf.com/segmentation/1.0/flywire_public",
  segments = "720575940621039145"
)
fw$source
#> [1] "graphene://middleauth+https://prod.flywire-daf.com/segmentation/1.0/flywire_public"
